patch.value: Define freshness evidence after bulk rollback for legacy memory clocks

Legacy memories without memory_changed_at use updated_at as their content clock. Guarded rollback restores their guidance and verification fields, then writes a new updated_at. A previously fresh result can therefore become unverified even when the prior guidance and verification history are intact.
Specify and test a conservative clock policy for restored legacy memories. Cover an intact prior verified state, prior unverified evidence, and an intervening native guidance edit.

In a scratch tracker, create linked verified knowledge without memory_changed_at and with memory_verified_at equal to updated_at. Confirm resume-evidence reports fresh. Change the body with update-many and roll it back using the combined checkpoint, then recall again.
The rollback restores the body and verification timestamp. Resume-evidence reports unverified and points to updated_at, which advanced on rollback.
